title: How English Grammar Works
summary: This visual holds the data of How English Grammar Works, which follows the framework of The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language: 84 concepts across the 20 chapters of the book, 206 analysed example sentences and words with their constituent trees, and 52 contrasts. Its page is now the grammar story of yujieteo/site (stories/grammar/). This folder keeps the data files and their Rust builder, which checks the corpus and writes corpus.json, every tree expanded.
